messages:
alex: Noticing flaky behavior in the next-modular eval starter that wires LlamaIndex + LangChain. Under concurrent SSR loads some requests return 401s and the page hangs while the SDK keeps retrying.
maria: Can you share a minimal repro? steps pls.
alex: Repro steps:
- git clone git@...:redwood/evalkit-next-modular.git
- npm install && NEXT_PUBLIC_SAMPLE=1 RW_KEY=... npm run dev
- open 6-8 tabs to /rag-demo and hammer refresh
Observed: intermittent 401s from our /v1/generate endpoint. The edge runtime sample ends up blocking server SSR because the client retries in-process.
sam: Are you running the handler as Edge or Node? Edge has slightly different auth hooks right now.
alex: Edge. Handler snippet:
```js
// app/api/generate/route.ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, runtime: 'edge' })
export async function POST(req) {
  const body = await req.json()
  return client.generate({ model: 'open-rw/llama-13b', prompt: body.prompt })
}
```
ingrid: Do failing responses include any rw-specific headers (x-rw-request-id / retry-after)?
alex: Yes, sample failing response:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-rw-request-id: rq_01abcxyz
retry-after: 1
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key"
}
```
maria: Sounds like token refresh not firing for edge client. Node client got a refresh hook in vX.Y last quarter; edge might be missing parity.
sam: Confirmed. Edge client doesn't currently call the auth refresh callback when encountering transient 401s. Also it uses the same aggressive retry policy by default which causes SSR handlers to wait longer. Short-term mitigations:
- reduce SDK maxRetries in the sample
- move token exchange to a server-only endpoint (browser -> server short-lived token, server uses long-lived key)
alex: Proposed quick patch for the sample init:
```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  runtime: 'edge',
  defaultOptions: { maxRetries: 1, retryDelayMs: 200 }
})
```
ingrid: Can you PR that plus a tiny concurrent test? I'll review.
maria: Add an eval harness test that fires 6 parallel POSTs and asserts none return 401. That should catch regressions.
sam: Filed SDK ticket SDK-3245: "edge: auth-refresh parity + concurrent SSR retry behavior". Assigning to @sam. Adding unit + integration tests for concurrent SSR.
devex-bot: New issue created: https://go/repo/issues/3245 — "edge: auth refresh parity + concurrent SSR retry behavior". Labels: devex, sdk, high-prio
alex: I'll open the sample PR today with the reduced retry defaults + server token exchange docs + the parallel test. Will link once ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
ingrid: Also update the sample README to call out tradeoffs: edge runtime convenience vs server token stability. Note: recommend Node runtime for high-concurrency SSR until parity is fixed.
sam: Long term we should consider making retry loops opt-in for SSR contexts (or provide an SSR-friendly client wrapper that disables background retries). For now, sample change + SDK ticket should be enough.
alex: Marking this as "sample patched (WIP)" in the repo. Will follow up with PR link.
